correctness.rationale: Under U_i=1, the first i values form a uniform i-subset, Pi(i) is its maximum with mean i(n+1)/(i+1), earlier coordinate means i(n+1)/(2(i+1)), and later coordinate means (n+1)/2. Multiplication by P(U_i=1)=1/i yields the exact stated arbitrary-real-weight covariance. D=2 sum_j j^2-2 sum_j j Pi(j) gives both Spearman covariance and conditional means. Summing positions produces harmonic Q covariance; classical independent-record law and Var(R)=1/(n-1) yield the exact correlation ~3/sqrt(n log n). Independently brute-enumerated all permutations n=2..7 and 27 (n,i) identities with a nontrivial signed quadratic weight vector; exact Fraction equality in all cases.
residual_risks: All random permutations uniform and complete/no ties; arbitrary real deterministic w, n>=2. No probabilistic independence between records and ranks inferred from covariance.

value.rationale: Arbitrary deterministic linear rank scores provide a natural complete local record-covariance law; its Spearman specialization identifies position-dependent record effects, exact conditional Spearman biases and the global 3/sqrt(n log n) decay. A future researcher working with record-conditioned nonparametric rank statistics could need these precise dependencies. Elementary proof does not itself make the motivated general formula merely an arbitrary exercise.
